title: Weak evidence blocks curator_auto and leaves no reusable selection

given.candidate: raw, standard, with exactly one photo evidence ref and follow_up_seen=false
given.curator: a valid current-run Training Data Curator result with curator_decision=selected

when.command: the server-side curator gate evaluates a curator_auto confirmation
when.policy: the strong-evidence policy requires at least two refs of two distinct kinds and follow_up_seen=true

then.transition: the confirmation is rejected with dataset_confirmation_policy_violation
then.state: candidate_status, quality_tier, confirmation_source stay unchanged and can_train_on remains false
then.authority: the selected current-run advisory and lifecycle mutation roll back together; model wording never enters policy evaluation
